bayts.text: his Family and his Companions; and occupy me with what You love, and make me blessed.
O You on Whom I lean with certainty, (bless) the Prophet, Banner of certainty (ʿAlam al-Yaqīn):
bless and grant peace, with all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
Bless with peace, O Lord of provisions, the Prophet, Pointer to good things (Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt),
his Family and his Companions, people of deeds; and through him make this composition the most excellent deed.
Bless him who validates good deeds, with a peace that draws good deeds,
his Family and his Companions, the best of communities; and turn no griefs toward my quarters.
Bless the Light of all luminaries, the Banner of guidance, the Forgiver of stumbles,
and grant him peace together with the Family and his Companions; and gather for me the wishes of good.
Bless with peace the one who pardons all slips, possessor of gifts,
his Family and his Companions; and illumine my record and accept my chapters.
Bless the possessor of precedence and excellence in every good, the Lord of Intercession,
his Family and the Companions, with peace, O You Who spared me denial as well as blame.
O best of hosts, with Whom is my abiding, (bless) the Prophet, Lord of the (praised) Station:
bless, with a lofty peace, together with the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Whose existence has never parted from eternity, bless the Sent One, Lord of the (firm) Footing,
and grant him peace with the noble Family and the Companions, and spare me what draws the forbidden.
O our Lord, bless him who is singled out with might and glory, him who is singled out
with lofty nobility, and grant peace for ever, with the Family and the Companions; and make all of me praiseworthy.
The two purest greetings of the Giver of abundant gifts upon the Prophet, Lord of the Means of Approach (al-Wasīla),
the Family and the Companions who excelled, just as through him hypocrisy has not headed toward me.
The blessing of Him Who made me safe from fear, upon the Prophet, the Select One, Lord of the sword,
upon his Family and his Companions, with peace, just as he brought from Him the most excellent of speech.
Upon the Prophet, Lord of excellence, the blessing of Him Who led his pre-eminence to him,
upon the Family and the Companions, with peace, just as through him (He) was for me with teaching.
And erase the wretchedness that had headed toward me, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), and make my heart a city of sciences.
The blessing of Him in Whom I am honoured and visited, upon my means of approach, Lord of the wrap (izār),
with peace, together with all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
Bless and grant peace upon him who is named Ṣāḥib al-Ḥujja (Lord of the proof), O You Who have gathered (all things),
his Family and his Companions, O You Who made my script like the service of the elect, and so it became.
Bless and grant peace, O Builder of homelands, upon the Prophet, Lord of authority,
his Family and his Companions, O You Who set each one upon Your upright path, and he walked it.
Bless and grant peace, O Remover of disease, upon the Messenger, Lord of the mantle (ridāʾ),
his Family and his Companions, O You Who illumined the heart of every upright one, and it shone.
Bless the possessor of wondrous radiance, that is, the Lord of the lofty degree,
with an enduring peace, together with the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
Bless and grant peace upon the Lord of the Crown, O You Who through him opened what was locked,
that is, the Lord of the helmet and of the Ascension (Miʿrāj), and upon the Family and the Companions, joy of the hopeful.
O You Who are established upon Your Throne (Qurʾān 20:5), (bless) the Messenger, Lord of the Banner:
bless and grant peace, together with all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O Giver of security and radiance, (bless) the Messenger, Lord of al-Burāq:
bless and grant peace, together with all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And be for me with the most excellent gifts, O You Who erased faults and sins.
And be for me with truthfulness and sincerity, O Giver of sufficiency and deliverance.
The blessing of Him Who filled without depletion, upon the Prophet, Lord of the staff (qaḍīb),
with His peace, together with his noble Family and his Companions, just as He gave without cease.
Bless with peace him who has been called Lord of the Seal, O You Who are invoked,
his Family and his Companions, O You Who turned toward me the heart of everyone You guided, and it turned.
O You Who bring forth charisma for us, (bless) the Prophet, Lord of the Sign (the seal of prophethood):
bless and grant peace, together with all the Family and his Companions, and answer my request for me.
Upon the Messenger, Lord of the Clear Proof, pour blessing and peace, together with those endowed with intellect
among his Family and his Companions; and aid me through Your believers, and through them gladden me.
Upon the Prophet, Lord of clarifying Eloquence, pour blessing and peace, together with those endowed with vision
among his Family and his Companions; and be for me without enmity, and illumine all of me.
Bless and grant peace, O Sender of the eloquent (Book), upon him who through You is eloquent of tongue,
his Family and his Companions; and soften for me the hearts of those who do not believe in You, that they may soften.
Bless the Chosen One, Ear of good (Qurʾān 9:61), of purified heart, O Lord of good,
and grant him peace with the illustrious Family and the Companions, and accept with thanks, out of generosity, this composition.
Upon one Kind and Merciful (Qurʾān 9:128), sound in Islam through his Lord, he who erased rancour:
bless and grant peace, with all the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
Bless with peace the Wellspring of bliss, the master of the two worlds, O Spreader of bliss,
